texts.zh: 方舟舰[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]的航程就此结束。经过数年的辛勤劳作，拆除了它的基础设施并将其运下重力井后，我们终于准备好将这艘飞船废弃。我们[event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在经历一个将被后代铭记的历史时刻。现在，让我们在[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]定居吧！
texts.en: Thus ends the voyage of the Arkship [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]. After years of labor, disassembling its infrastructure and carrying it down the gravity well, we are finally ready to scuttle the ship. We [event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are living through a moment future generations will remember. Now, let us settle [event_target:settled_planet.GetName]!

texts.zh: 将所有无人机和基础设施从[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]转移至一颗[event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon]上，这标志着[event_target:player_country.GetName]背离了预言中的未来。现在将开发新的优先队列，以适应定居生活。
texts.en: The transfer of all drones and infrastructure from the [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName] to a [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon] is a departure point from the predicted future of the [event_target:player_country.GetName]. New priority queues will now be developed to adapt to settled life.

texts.zh: 经过多年来对[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]基础设施的筹备以及对我们自身生理机能的改造，进化出更强健的骨骼与优化的肺部，如今我们已准备好定居。这将是[event_target:player_country.GetName]生命周期中的一个全新阶段，也许定居生活会很适合我们。
texts.en: After years of preparing the infrastructure of the [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName] and our own biology, evolving stronger bones and optimized lungs, we are now ready to settle. This will be a new stage in the [event_target:player_country.GetName] lifecycle, perhaps settled life will suit us.

texts.zh:
降落已经完成。有生以来第一次见到起落架踏入土壤时，每一个观察窗前斗挤满了旅客，一阵不整齐的欢呼声震动了船体。几小时内，第一批避难所便由回收的甲板板材搭建而成。孩子们在异星的草地上奔跑，而他们的父母则在开阔的天空下相对无言。

船员们静静地工作着，拆卸下为太空旅行设计的系统，并将它们重新改装以用于地面生存。曾经的一艘游轮，如今成了殖民地的脊梁。

无论好坏，巡游已经结束。
texts.en:
The descent is complete. Passengers crowd every viewport as landing struts bite into soil for the first time in living memory, and a ragged cheer shakes the hull. Within hours the first shelters rise from salvaged deck plating. Children run through alien grass while their parents stand speechless under an open sky.

The crew works quietly, unbolting systems built for void travel and repurposing them for groundside survival. What was a cruise ship is now a colony's spine.

For better or worse, the voyage is over.

texts.zh:
降落已完成。我们的子个体首次触及土壤，肢体在没有引擎震颤的地面上显得有些不稳。乘客们如潮水般涌出气闸，散布在他们奋力抵达的这片土地上。

集体围绕着行星的律动重新塑形：根系般的补给线向外延伸，取代了原有的走廊物流；营养加工也从船载循环储备转向直接从地景中汲取原始养分。

一个新的家园。蜂群必须存续，一如既往。
texts.en:
The descent is complete. Our drones touch soil for the first time, their limbs unsteady on ground that does not thrum with engine vibration. The passengers spill from the airlocks in waves, scattering across the landscape they fought to reach.

The collective reshapes itself around planetary rhythms: root-like supply lines spread to replace corridor logistics, and nutrient processing shifts from recycled shipboard stocks to raw nutrients drawn from the landscape.

A new home. The hive must endure, as it always has.

texts.zh:
行星切入完成。着陆装置自出厂以来首次接触地表。旅客正通过所有可用气闸舱撤离，其生物满意度指标处于前所未有的数值。

劳工单元已开始将舰载基础设施转换为地面作业用途。船体外壳正被切割成地基面板，导航阵列正重新校准为地面通信中继站。从真空到陆地运行参数的转变正在无间断推进。

新首要指令：建立并维护殖民地基础设施。
texts.en:
Planetary insertion complete. Landing gear has engaged terrain for the first time since original manufacture. Passengers are disembarking via all available airlocks, their biological satisfaction indicators at unprecedented readings.

Worker units have begun converting shipboard infrastructure for surface operations. Hull plating is being sectioned into foundation panels and navigation arrays recalibrated as ground-based communication relays. The transition from void to terrestrial operational parameters is proceeding without interruption.

New primary directive: Establish and maintain colony infrastructure.
